title: Project S.P.H.E.R.E. Public Research Portal, Technical Specifications, and Whitepaper v2.0
description: Source repository for spheredesci.org, including SPHERE-WP-001 Version 2.0 (Open Resonance Metrology, Experimental Controls, and Accountable Research Infrastructure), documentation for registered Protocol LOC-1 (OSF: https://osf.io/5b6mj/overview), proposed Phase 2 extensions, and independent track ANT-B-01. Project S.P.H.E.R.E. is at the pre-results readiness and qualification stage; hypotheses are not established conclusions.
